UI_PNC_Trait_Friendly_Description: More sociable, compassionate, and willing to forgive.
UI_PNC_Trait_Withdrawn_Description: Less sociable and less likely to seek interaction.
UI_PNC_Trait_Jealous_Description: More possessive and less forgiving during social conflict.
UI_PNC_Trait_Unpossessive_Description: Less possessive and more forgiving during social conflict.
UI_PNC_Trait_Flirty_Description: More comfortable initiating romantic or playful interaction.
UI_PNC_Trait_Reserved_Description: Less likely to initiate romantic or intimate interaction.
UI_PNC_Trait_IronNerves_Description: Recovers composure more easily and remains calmer under pressure.
UI_PNC_Trait_FrayedNerves_Description: Stress and panic build more quickly, especially under danger.
UI_PNC_Trait_BusyHands_Description: Boredom grows more slowly while the NPC has useful work.
UI_PNC_Trait_RestlessSoul_Description: The NPC becomes restless during inactivity and recreation is more urgent.
UI_PNC_Trait_Hardy_Description: Hunger and thirst build more slowly.
UI_PNC_Trait_Delicate_Description: Hunger and thirst build more quickly.
UI_PNC_Trait_SecondWind_Description: Fatigue builds more slowly after the NPC becomes heavily tired.
UI_PNC_Trait_LightSleeper_Description: Fatigue builds more slowly and the NPC needs less time asleep.
UI_PNC_Trait_HeavySleeper_Description: The NPC needs deeper and longer sleep before waking refreshed.
UI_PNC_Trait_TriggerHappy_Description: Fires sooner and more often, but sacrifices firearm accuracy, especially under pressure.
UI_PNC_Trait_Brawler_Description: A practical fighter who attacks quickly and holds up reasonably well under pressure.
UI_PNC_Trait_DisciplinedFighter_Descript: Fights methodically, sacrificing speed for accuracy and composure.
UI_PNC_Trait_Reckless_Description: Commits to rapid attacks before fully controlling the swing, especially under pressure.
UI_PNC_Trait_CautiousFighter_Description: Takes longer to commit but favors careful, accurate strikes.
UI_PNC_Trait_Berserker_Description: Throws aggressive attacks with frightening speed but loses precision in crowded fights.
UI_PNC_Trait_Cowardly_Description: Hesitates in close combat and becomes markedly less reliable under pressure.
UI_PNC_Trait_Veteran_Description: Experienced in violence, making deliberate and accurate attacks even when surrounded.
UI_PNC_Trait_NervousFighter_Description: Acts quickly out of fear but loses accuracy when the fight becomes chaotic.
UI_PNC_Trait_Patient_Description: Waits for better openings and retains accuracy under pressure.
UI_PNC_Trait_Hasty_Description: Rushes into attacks, gaining speed at the cost of precision.
UI_PNC_Trait_Scrapper_Description: A resilient close-range fighter with a modest advantage in messy engagements.
UI_PNC_Trait_Peacemaker_Description: Avoids violence where possible and commits slowly, but stays composed when forced to fight.
